title: Swarm Construction Sites Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Swarm Construction Sites: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Swarm Construction Sites — construction sites run entirely by swarms.

Phase 1 — Prove (builder swarms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (site logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (blueprint sharing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (safety zones): site hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and construction-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
